name: elb
description: Elastic Load Balancing A load balancer can distribute incoming traffic across your EC2 instances.

subcommands.name: add-tags
subcommands.description: Adds the specified tags to the specified load balancer.

subcommands.name: apply-security-groups-to-load-balancer
subcommands.description: Associates one or more security groups with your load balancer in a virtual private cloud (VPC).

subcommands.name: attach-load-balancer-to-subnets
subcommands.description: Adds one or more subnets to the set of configured subnets for the specified load balancer.

subcommands.name: configure-health-check
subcommands.description: Specifies the health check settings to use when evaluating the health state of your EC2 instances.

subcommands.name: create-app-cookie-stickiness-policy
subcommands.description: Generates a stickiness policy with sticky session lifetimes that follow that of an application-generated cookie.

subcommands.name: create-lb-cookie-stickiness-policy
subcommands.description: Generates a stickiness policy with sticky session lifetimes controlled by the lifetime of the browser (user-agent) or a specified expiration period.

subcommands.name: create-load-balancer
subcommands.description: Creates a Classic Load Balancer.

subcommands.name: create-load-balancer-listeners
subcommands.description: Creates one or more listeners for the specified load balancer.

subcommands.name: create-load-balancer-policy
subcommands.description: Creates a policy with the specified attributes for the specified load balancer.

subcommands.name: delete-load-balancer
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified load balancer.

subcommands.name: delete-load-balancer-listeners
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified listeners from the specified load balancer.

subcommands.name: delete-load-balancer-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified policy from the specified load balancer.

subcommands.name: deregister-instances-from-load-balancer
subcommands.description: Deregisters the specified instances from the specified load balancer.

subcommands.name: describe-account-limits
subcommands.description: Describes the current Elastic Load Balancing resource limits for your AWS account.

subcommands.name: describe-instance-health
subcommands.description: Describes the state of the specified instances with respect to the specified load balancer.

subcommands.name: describe-load-balancer-attributes
subcommands.description: Describes the attributes for the specified load balancer.

subcommands.name: describe-load-balancer-policies
subcommands.description: Describes the specified policies.

subcommands.name: describe-load-balancer-policy-types
subcommands.description: Describes the specified load balancer policy types or all load balancer policy types.

subcommands.name: describe-load-balancers
subcommands.description: Describes the specified the load balancers.

subcommands.name: describe-tags
subcommands.description: Describes the tags associated with the specified load balancers.

subcommands.name: detach-load-balancer-from-subnets
subcommands.description: Removes the specified subnets from the set of configured subnets for the load balancer.

subcommands.name: disable-availability-zones-for-load-balancer
subcommands.description: Removes the specified Availability Zones from the set of Availability Zones for the specified load balancer in EC2-Classic or a default VPC.

subcommands.name: enable-availability-zones-for-load-balancer
subcommands.description: Adds the specified Availability Zones to the set of Availability Zones for the specified load balancer in EC2-Classic or a default VPC.

subcommands.name: modify-load-balancer-attributes
subcommands.description: Modifies the attributes of the specified load balancer.

subcommands.name: register-instances-with-load-balancer
subcommands.description: Adds the specified instances to the specified load balancer.

subcommands.name: remove-tags
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from the specified load balancer.

subcommands.name: set-load-balancer-listener-ssl-certificate
subcommands.description: Sets the certificate that terminates the specified listener's SSL connections.

subcommands.name: set-load-balancer-policies-for-backend-server
subcommands.description: Replaces the set of policies associated with the specified port on which the EC2 instance is listening with a new set of policies.

subcommands.name: set-load-balancer-policies-of-listener
subcommands.description: Replaces the current set of policies for the specified load balancer port with the specified set of policies.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: any-instance-in-service
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query InstanceStates[].State returns InService for any element when polling with ``describe-instance-health``.

subcommands.name: instance-deregistered
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query InstanceStates[].State returns OutOfService for all elements when polling with ``describe-instance-health``.

subcommands.name: instance-in-service
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query InstanceStates[].State returns InService for all elements when polling with ``describe-instance-health``.
